Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was India's ambassador to the Soviet Union from 1949 to 1952, succeeding Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit. The team note is wrong: Radhakrishnan was a philosopher and academic, not an Indian Civil Service officer, so the note should not be relied on. I did not reopen the Wilson Center link in this turn, so the Stalin-meeting detail rests on my earlier recall.

CONFIDENCE: 90
